description: Source code for the BuilderRecord class, which manages build dependency records in a build system, including dependency addition, resolution, and classification.

classes.name: BuilderRecord
classes.description: Represents a build dependency record, managing dependencies, resolution status, and dependency types within a build graph.

methods.name: BuilderRecord::GetNameForType
methods.description: Returns a string name corresponding to the ItemType enum value.

methods.name: BuilderRecord::IsItemOfType
methods.description: Checks if a given Item matches a specified ItemType.

methods.name: BuilderRecord::TypeOfItem
methods.description: Determines the ItemType of a given Item.

methods.name: BuilderRecord::AddDep
methods.description: Adds a dependency record and updates unresolved counts if necessary.

methods.name: BuilderRecord::AddGenDep
methods.description: Adds a generated dependency record without waiting for resolution.

methods.name: BuilderRecord::AddValidationDep
methods.description: Adds a validation dependency, affecting resolution and validation counts.

methods.name: BuilderRecord::OnDefinedDep
methods.description: Handles the event when a dependency is defined, updating unresolved counts.

methods.name: BuilderRecord::OnResolvedDep
methods.description: Handles the event when a dependency is resolved, updating unresolved counts.

methods.name: BuilderRecord::OnResolvedValidationDep
methods.description: Handles the event when a validation dependency is resolved, updating validation counts.

methods.name: BuilderRecord::GetSortedUnresolvedDeps
methods.description: Returns a sorted list of unresolved dependencies related to this record.
